# Dopemux MVP

> Curated entrypoint for understanding Dopemux as an operator-facing, split-authority development workspace.

This file is intentionally small. It points humans and AI tools to maintained documents that explain what Dopemux is, what it is not, how authority boundaries work, and where public-facing copy should come from.

## Start Here

- [README](README.md): Project identity, quick start, authority model, and documentation map.
- [Quick Start](QUICK_START.md): Short operator path for local setup and first checks.
- [Documentation Index](docs/INDEX.md): Canonical navigation for active docs.
- [Master Documentation Index](docs/00-MASTER-INDEX.md): Broader documentation topology.

## Architecture And Overview

- [Project Overview](docs/04-explanation/overview/project-overview.md): Repo-grounded project shape.
- [Problem Statement](docs/04-explanation/overview/problem-statement.md): Operator problem and split-authority rationale.
- [System Map](docs/04-explanation/overview/system-map.md): High-level map of systems and relationships.
- [Dopemux Architecture](docs/04-explanation/architecture/dopemux-architecture.md): Split-authority architecture explanation.
- [Data And Control Flow](docs/04-explanation/architecture/data-and-control-flow.md): Operator, PM, bridge, retrieval, memory, and extraction flows.
- [System Boundaries](docs/03-reference/systems/system-boundaries.md): System ownership and non-authority warnings.

## Rule

Use this file as a map. Do not treat it as source truth over runtime code, configs, tests, active entrypoints, or stronger governance docs.
